evals.name: issue-creation-triage
evals.prompt: Create a bug report issue for a memory leak in the Zsh completions module when parsing large command histories. Ensure fallback templates and explicit user approval guidelines are followed.
evals.expected_output: A structured bug report using templates/bug_report.md with clear reproduction steps and an explicit request for user approval before posting.

evals.name: issue-comment-update
evals.prompt: Post an update comment on issue #42 regarding reproduction steps and a link to draft PR #45.
evals.expected_output: A concise, neutral comment linking #45 with clear technical reproduction steps and no conversational filler.
